title: Edinburgh, Scotland: Royal Mile - Rick Steves’ Europe Travel Guide - Travel Bite
speaker: Rick Steves' Europe
zh: 【Rick Steves' Europe】蘇格蘭愛丁堡：皇家大道 - Rick Steves 的歐洲旅遊指南 - Travel Bite（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Old Edinburgh's main drag — nicknamed The Royal Mile — leads from the castle
cues.en: Old Edinburgh's main drag — nicknamed The Royal Mile — leads from the castle
cues.zh: 舊愛丁堡的主要街道——綽號“皇家大道”——從城堡延伸出來

cues.text: downhill through the Old Town to the palace.
cues.en: downhill through the Old Town to the palace.
cues.zh: 下坡穿過老城區就到了皇宮。

cues.text: This colorful jumble is the tourists' Edinburgh: a dense tangle of historic buildings,
cues.en: This colorful jumble is the tourists' Edinburgh: a dense tangle of historic buildings,
cues.zh: 這片色彩繽紛的雜亂地就是遊客的愛丁堡：歷史建築密密麻麻，

cues.text: fun museums and cultural cliches on sale.
cues.en: fun museums and cultural cliches on sale.
cues.zh: 有趣的博物館和文化陳詞濫調出售。

cues.text: Edinburgh was a wonder in the 17th and 18th centuries. It was famed for its skyscrapers — they say the first anywhere —
cues.en: Edinburgh was a wonder in the 17th and 18th centuries. It was famed for its skyscrapers — they say the first anywhere —
cues.zh: 愛丁堡是 17 世紀和 18 世紀的奇蹟。它以其摩天大樓而聞名——他們說這是世界上第一座摩天大樓——

cues.text: but also for its filth.
cues.en: but also for its filth.
cues.zh: 但也因為它的汙穢。

cues.text: It was once the most congested city in Europe. Its most wretched couldn't even
cues.en: It was once the most congested city in Europe. Its most wretched couldn't even
cues.zh: 它曾經是歐洲最擁擠的城市。最悲慘的甚至不能

cues.text: afford candles. They lived in darkness. It's said they knew each other not by how they looked,
cues.en: afford candles. They lived in darkness. It's said they knew each other not by how they looked,
cues.zh: 買得起蠟燭。他們生活在黑暗中。據說他們不是透過外表認識的

cues.text: but by how they smelled.
cues.en: but by how they smelled.
cues.zh: 而是透過它們的氣味。

cues.text: Medieval skyscrapers towered ten stories and higher.
cues.en: Medieval skyscrapers towered ten stories and higher.
cues.zh: 中世紀的摩天大樓高達十層樓甚至更高。

cues.text: Frontage and High Street was so limited that the buildings were narrow and tall
cues.en: Frontage and High Street was so limited that the buildings were narrow and tall
cues.zh: 臨街面和高街非常有限，因此建築物又窄又高

cues.text: crammed shoulder to shoulder with little courtyards called "closes" branching off.
cues.en: crammed shoulder to shoulder with little courtyards called "closes" branching off.
cues.zh: 並排擠滿了被稱為「封閉」的小庭院。

cues.text: These closes were connected to the main drag by skinny lanes or even tunnels.
cues.en: These closes were connected to the main drag by skinny lanes or even tunnels.
cues.zh: 這些路口透過窄巷甚至隧道與主幹道相連。

cues.text: Four hundred years ago Edinburgh was nicknamed "Auld Reekie." The entire city was a black-stained mess of chimneys and reeked of smoke.
cues.en: Four hundred years ago Edinburgh was nicknamed "Auld Reekie." The entire city was a black-stained mess of chimneys and reeked of smoke.
cues.zh: 四百年前，愛丁堡被暱稱為「Auld Reekie」。整個城市都是一片漆黑的煙囪，散發著濃濃​​的煙燻味。

cues.text: The Royal Mile ends at the gates of Holyrood Palace — for five hundred years
cues.en: The Royal Mile ends at the gates of Holyrood Palace — for five hundred years
cues.zh: 皇家大道的終點是荷里路德宮大門－五百年來

cues.text: the official royal residence here in Edinburgh.
cues.en: the official royal residence here in Edinburgh.
cues.zh: 愛丁堡的官方皇家住所。

cues.text: For several centuries, Scotland was ruled from London.
cues.en: For several centuries, Scotland was ruled from London.
cues.zh: 幾個世紀以來，蘇格蘭一直受到倫敦的統治。

cues.text: Parliament hadn't met here since 1707.
cues.en: Parliament hadn't met here since 1707.
cues.zh: 自 1707 年以來，議會就沒有在這裡召開過會議。

cues.text: Recently, the Scots voted to bring their parliament home and London didn't object.
cues.en: Recently, the Scots voted to bring their parliament home and London didn't object.
cues.zh: 最近，蘇格蘭人投票決定將議會帶回家，倫敦也沒有反對。

cues.text: In the year 2000, Edinburgh resumed its position as home of Scotland's parliament.
cues.en: In the year 2000, Edinburgh resumed its position as home of Scotland's parliament.
cues.zh: 2000年，愛丁堡恢復了蘇格蘭議會所在地的地位。

cues.text: Scotland's strikingly modern parliament building opened in 2004.
cues.en: Scotland's strikingly modern parliament building opened in 2004.
cues.zh: 蘇格蘭引人注目的現代議會大廈於 2004 年啟用。

cues.text: The Catalan architect, Enric Miralles, mixed old windows, wild angles and organic
cues.en: The Catalan architect, Enric Miralles, mixed old windows, wild angles and organic
cues.zh: 加泰隆尼亞建築師 Enric Miralles 混合了舊窗戶、狂野的角度和有機的元素

cues.text: themes into a startling complex that would, as he envisioned,
cues.en: themes into a startling complex that would, as he envisioned,
cues.zh: 將主題融入一個令人震驚的複雜之中，正如他所設想的那樣，

cues.text: surge from out of the rock and into the city.
cues.en: surge from out of the rock and into the city.
cues.zh: 從岩石中湧出並進入城市。
